response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and distributed systems, plus a CS degree — technically far beyond what this entry-level role requires. However, the position is explicitly junior, and the mismatch in seniority creates serious risks around compensation expectations, motivation, and retention. More decisively, the role requires strong verbal and written German for client-facing insurance consulting work, and his German is listed as basic. His recent stack is TypeScript/Node/DLang; Java appears only in a role from 2016–2018, so the core language requirement is dated and peripheral. He could be an excellent candidate for a mid/senior opening at the same company if German-language requirements were relaxed, but he is not a fit for this posting.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience with strong agile/TDD/CI craftsmanship background
CS degree plus proven architecture, cloud, Docker/Kubernetes and DevOps exposure
Demonstrated communication skills via public talks, workshops, and teaching courses
concerns: Basic German conflicts with required fluency for client-facing insurance projects
Java experience is limited and roughly a decade out of date
Severely overqualified for an entry-level role; retention and salary mismatch risk
